# CuiSharp

> CuiSharp binds CUI, a C99 immediate-mode UI library, to C#. It draws native
> windows with no XAML, no WPF, no Avalonia and no web view. Rebuild the whole UI
> every frame from your own fields; there is no control tree, no binding and
> nothing to invalidate.

## Rules

- `Draw(Ui ui)` runs every frame, synchronously. Never `await`, `.Result`, `.Wait()` or `Thread.Sleep` in it.
- `Ui` and every scope are `ref struct`: no fields, no capture, no `await`. State lives in your own fields.
- Scopes are `using` blocks; interactive widgets take `ref` and return `bool`.
- Text fields take `ref string`; CUI edits the value and returns it on the frames it changed.
- A widget id is a stable string. Inside a loop, wrap each row in `using (ui.Id(item.Id))`, or enumerate `ui.Keyed(items, key)`.
- Long work goes through `Mutation`: create it once, call `Run()` from a button, read `IsRunning` and `Error`.
- A page that changes on its own needs `WantsFrames => true`, or the window sleeps.
- Per-frame code allocates nothing: no LINQ, no `new`, no string concatenation. Interpolate into a widget instead.
- Find a control in a frame by a query: a label (`Save`), a kind and a label (`Button "Save"`), or a path (`Card "editor" > Save`).

## Entry points

- `CuiApp.Run(options, ui => ...)` — one window, one callback per frame.
- `CuiApplication.CreateBuilder(args)` + `Run<TRoot>()` — hosted app with DI and `Component` pages.
- `CuiSurface.Create(w, h)` + `surface.Draw(render, pixels)` — headless frame for tests and benchmarks.

## Testing and tools

- `TestApp.Start(component, w, h)` — drive a real component with no window: `FindButton("Save").Click()`, `FindInput("draft")` + `Type("Milk")`, `Frame(n)`, `Focus()`, `Key(key)`, `Faults`, `PaintedAnything()`, `SavePng(path)`.
- `app.Tree` / `app.Print()` — the frame as the app drew it, nesting included; `SemanticNode.Find(query)`, `Descendants()`, `Path`.
- `HeadlessApp` — the same driver in the framework, which `TestApp` names; `dotnet cui` drives it in a real process.
- A tab strip and a segmented control record one control per item (`Tab "Markets"`, `Segment "Dark"`), so an item is found and clicked like any other control.
- `surface.LastFrame` -> `FrameSample` — what the last frame that surface drew cost: `DrawMs`, `AllocatedBytes`, `FrameMs`, `Fps`, `IsLive`. `FrameStats` holds the same for the one window in the process, which is what a footer reads.
- `dotnet cui tree|find|click|type|key|focus|move|frame|faults|png` — one command per line, `--stdin` for a session, `--app` for a published build, `--no-build`, `--frames N`. Any app opts in by running headless (`CUISHARP_HEADLESS=1` or `--headless`).

## Core API (hand-written, in `src/CuiSharp/Ui`)

- `ui.Input(UiText id, ref string value, InputOpts o = default)` -> `InputResult` — single-line text field.
- `ui.TextArea(...)`, `ui.Search(...)` — the same shape, multi-line and search affordances.
- `ui.Number(UiText id, ref double value, double min, double max, NumberOpts o = default)` -> `bool`.
- `ui.LineChart(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<float> values, ChartOpts o = default, Color color = default)` — one series, draws nothing when empty.
- `ui.BarChart(...)` — the same for bars; `ui.LineChart(id, Series[] series, ...)` for several series.
- `ui.DonutChart(UiText id, float[] values, string[]? labels = null, ChartOpts o = default)`.
- `ui.Canvas(UiText id, Size width, Size height, PaintFn paint)` — custom drawing: `paint(ui, box)` with `ui.DrawLine`, `DrawRect`, `DrawCircle`, `DrawText`, `DrawPath`.
- `ui.Id(int)`, `ui.Id(UiText)` -> `IDisposable` — a scope that prefixes every id inside it; `ui.Keyed(items, key)` enumerates with ids.
- `ui.Shortcut(Mods mods, Key key)` -> `bool`, `ui.WantsKeyboard` — keyboard input, unmodified when a text field has focus.
- `ui.RequestRedraw()`, `ui.NeedsRedraw` — rarely needed directly: the host does this from `WantsFrames` and pending work.
- `ui.RequestWakeup(float seconds)` — one more frame this many seconds from now: a timer, a toast timeout, a poll interval.
- `ui.LastId` -> `uint` — the id of the widget just drawn; what `TourStep.Target` and the other point-at-this APIs take.
- `ui.Terminal(UiText id, Terminal terminal, TerminalOpts o = default)` -> `TerminalResult` — the `Terminal` class owns the scrollback (`Write`, `WriteLine`, `Clear`, `LineCount`).
- `ui.LogView(UiText id, LogBuffer log, LogViewOpts o = default)` — `LogBuffer` owns the ring (`Append`, `AppendLine`, `Text`, `Clear`), the view adds level filters, search, follow and copy.
- `ui.MeasureText(text, size, font)` -> `TextMetrics`; `ui.Time`, `ui.DeltaTime`, `ui.FrameCount`, `ui.DpiScale`; `ui.MousePosition`, `ui.MouseDown`, `ui.MouseClicked`, `ui.KeyDown`, `ui.KeyPressed`, `ui.Modifiers`, `ui.WantsMouse`; `ui.RectOf(id)`; `ui.IsDisabled` and `using (ui.Disabled(flag)) { ... }`.
- `ui.DrawRect`, `DrawRectGradient`, `DrawShadow`, `DrawLine`, `DrawPolyline`, `DrawPolygon`, `DrawCircle`, `DrawArc`, `DrawText`, `DrawIcon`, `DrawImage`, `using (ui.Clip(rect))` — the primitives a custom control paints with.
- `ui.HexView(id, Span<byte>, ref HexSelection, HexViewOpts)` — the editable hex view; the span is pinned, so a typed byte lands in your array.
- `ui.TreeTable(id, columns, TreeNode[], row, [ref TableSort, ref int], TreeTableOpts, label)` -> `TreeTableEvents` — a tree over a flat node array the table rewrites; `events.Load` names the nodes whose children it wants, and `CuiTree.Sort(nodes, root, compare)` relinks siblings.
- `ui.State<T>(id)` and `ui.State(id, onFree)` -> `Span<T>` — per-id scratch that survives frames; the second form adds a callback CUI runs when it evicts that id (release a texture, a lease, a pooled buffer).
- `ui.DiffRows(id, Span<DiffRow>, first)` — the live diff view's rows, for a custom renderer.
- `Color.Oklch(l, c, hue, alpha)`, `Color.Mix(a, b, t)`, `color.WithAlpha(f)`, `ui.ColorOf(color)`, `ui.TokenColor(token)`, `Ui.AccentName(accent)`, `Ui.KeyName(key)`.
- `CuiMath.DiffLines(old, new)` / `DiffWords(old, new)` / `EvaluateCurve(keys, x)` / `EvaluateGradient(stops, t)` / `PathMatches(path, filter)`; `MarkdownText.ToggleTask(ref text, offset, result)`; `CuiFiles.ListDirectory(path)`; `CuiSurface` input: `MouseMove`, `MouseDown`, `MouseUp`, `Click`, `Scroll`, `KeyDown`, `KeyUp`, `Type`, `Focus`, `FileDrop`.
- `ui.Theme` and `ui.Accent`: assign `Theme.Dark` or `Accent.Blue` from inside any frame and CUI animates the change; `ui.ToggleTheme()` is the dark-mode command.

- `ui.Toolbar(UiText id, ToolbarOpts o = default)` → `LayoutScope`  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))

- `ui.AvatarUpload(UiText id, UiText name, ref ulong image, float size)` → `int` — Avatar upload: a round avatar that takes a dropped image, with a camera badge on hover. Returns 1 when *image changed, -1 when clicked (browse), 0 otherwise. A dropped image is loaded with cui_image_load.  ([Capture](api/Capture.md))

- `ui.CodeEditorGoto(UiText id, int line, int column)` → `void` — On the editor's next frame: put the caret at a line and column (1 based), focus the editor and scroll there. Call from the same id scope.  ([Code editor](api/CodeEditor.md))
- `ui.CodeEditorSelect(UiText id, int anchor, int cursor)` → `void` — On the next frame: select bytes anchor..cursor, focus and scroll there.  ([Code editor](api/CodeEditor.md))
- `ui.CommandPalette(ref bool open, ReadOnlySpan<Command> commands)` → `int` — Spotlight style command palette. Returns the index of the chosen command, or -1. Open it with a shortcut: if (cui_shortcut(ui, CUI_MOD_PRIMARY, CUI_KEY_K)) open = true;  ([Command palette (block)](api/CommandPaletteBlock.md))

- `ui.DockSave(UiText id, ref string buf, int cap)` → `ulong` — Saved layout: one line, e.g. dock1 h0.22([*Scene tree,Assets],v0.7([*Viewport],[*Log,-Console])) h splits side by side and v stacks, the number is the first child's share, [..] is a leaf's tabs in order, * the selected tab, - a closed panel; a backslash escapes , [ ] ( ) and itself in names. cui_dock_save returns the full length (as snprintf does) and writes what fits, or 0 when there is no layout. cui_dock_load replaces the layout (and sets each panel's *open from it on its next frame); names it does not know yet are kept for when they appear. Malformed text returns false and changes nothing.  ([Docking](api/Docking.md))

- `ui.DrawEmoji(UiText utf8, RectF r)` → `void`  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.Emoji(UiText utf8, float size)` → `void`  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.EmojiFontLoadFile(UiText path)` → `bool` — ---- Emoji ---- Color emoji come from an emoji font: the system's (cui_emoji_font_load_system, which the picker calls by itself when nothing is loaded) or one the app ships. Bitmap color fonts (sbix as on macOS, CBDT as on Linux and Android) and layered ones (COLR version 0, as on Windows) are read, as is a plain outline font for one-color emoji. Sequences with skin tones, joined people and flags are looked up through the font's ligatures. Big fonts are read from the file as needed rather than loaded whole. Drawn emoji are kept in one texture and reused.  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.EmojiFontLoadMemory(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, bool copy)` → `bool`  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.EmojiFontLoadSystem()` → `bool`  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.EmojiPicker(UiText id, ref string recent, ref int tone, EmojiPickerOpts o = default)` → `string?`  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.EmojiSupported(UiText utf8)` → `bool`  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))
- `ui.FeatureFlags(UiText id, Span<FeatureFlag> flags, ReadOnlySpan<string> envs, FeatureFlagsOpts o = default)` → `FeatureFlagsResult`  ([Feature flags](api/FeatureFlags.md))

- `ui.EmptyState(UiText title, EmptyOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Empty state. Returns true when its action button is clicked.  ([Feedback and display](api/FeedbackAndDisplay.md))
- `ui.Meter(UiText label, float used, float total, UiText unit = default)` → `void`  ([Feedback and display](api/FeedbackAndDisplay.md))

## Documents

- [Options](api/Options.md): every option struct and its fields.
- [Records](api/Records.md): item types for the widgets that take arrays.
- [Hosting](hosting.md): components, mutation, dependency injection.

## Members with no C function behind them

Hand-written, because the wrapper needs state a C call cannot carry; they are part of the same `ui`.

- `ui.AccentName(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Frame.cs`
- `ui.AddFontFallback(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Fonts.cs`
- `ui.Animate(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Draw.cs`
- `ui.AnimateSpring(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Draw.cs`

- [Widgets](widgets.md) and [more widgets](widgets-more.md): what each component does, and what it does with the keyboard.
- [Native ABI](native-abi.md): the RIDs the package carries, and the glibc floor.
- [Guide](SKILL.md): the authoring rules, the pitfalls, the component list.

Every path above is in this folder, which is the whole of what an app needs: it is the same
folder in the repository and in the package, and nothing in it points outside itself.
